question: In ΔXYZ, P and Q are the points on sides XY and XZ respectively. PQ is parallel to YZ and PQ ∶ YZ = 3 ∶ 8. If XY = 88 cm, then what is the length of XP?
solution:
**Given:**

P and Q are the points on sides XY and XZ respectively.

PQ is parallel to YZ.

PQ ∶ YZ = 3 ∶ 8

XY = 88 cm

Concept used:

If a line parallel to one side of a triangle intersects the other two sides of the triangle, then the line divides these two sides proportionally.

**Calculation:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3b1329489e1ac60bbdbcc29aeb2ad9cfdec6fbd81e695b522fac3e703a572661.png] 

According to the concept,

ΔXYZ ∼ ΔXPQ [Basic Proportionality Theorem]

So,

XP/XY = PQ/YZ = 3/8

XY = 88 cm

⇒ XP/XY = 3/8

⇒ x/88 = 3/8

⇒ x = 33 cm

XP = 33 cm

**∴ Option 1 is the correct answer.**
